children: MIRA advanced its Ketamir-2 Phase 2a CIPN trial protocol to IRB review after FDA feedback and is targeting site initiation in Q1 2027.
Phase 2a protocol for Ketamir-2 in chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy submitted for IRB review after FDA comments.
Company incorporated FDA feedback and is targeting site initiation in Q1 2027, subject to IRB and site activation completion.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled three-period crossover will test 300 mg and 600 mg doses versus placebo.
Study designed to assess safety, tolerability, efficacy, and dose-response on neuropathic pain intensity; builds on favorable Phase 1 data.
MIRA plans scientific presentations in October and continues licensing and partnership discussions for Ketamir-2.

title: MIRA advances Ketamir-2 to Phase 2a after FDA review, targets Q1 2027 site starts
